task_title: OPS-008 semantic recall latency: bound on-the-fly embedding concurrency so a cache-miss ?q= stays inside the 30s budget
task_criteria: Measured: provider round-trip 2.3-7.6s (healthy), daemon ?q= 28-40s consistent incl. repeat query; attribution = serial on-the-fly embeds capped at 10 in recall.ts:371 x provider RTT. AC1: search.ts batches missing-vector embeds with bounded concurrency (reuse rebuild.ts worker-pool pattern) instead of a serial await in the scan loop. AC2: a warm-cache query is unchanged in behaviour (same ranking, same minScore floor). AC3: regression test asserts N cache-miss candidates are embedded with concurrency>1 (no serial 10x RTT wall) and that a single failing embed no longer stalls the rest of the batch. AC4: unit suite + tsc + prettier clean. AC5: live re-measure of authed GET /api/memories?namespace=duckbrain&q=... shows a materially lower wall time than the 28-40s baseline, documented in the tick event.

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Measured: provider round-trip 2.3-7.6s (healthy), daemon ?q= 28-40s consistent incl. repeat query; attribution = serial on-the-fly embeds capped at 10 in recall.ts:371 x provider RTT. AC1: search.ts batches missing-vector embeds with bounded concurrency (reuse rebuild.ts worker-pool pattern) instead of a serial await in the scan loop. AC2: a warm-cache query is unchanged in behaviour (same ranking, same minScore floor). AC3: regression test asserts N cache-miss candidates are embedded with concurrency>1 (no serial 10x RTT wall) and that a single failing embed no longer stalls the rest of the batch. AC4: unit suite + tsc + prettier clean. AC5: live re-measure of authed GET /api/memories?namespace=duckbrain&q=... shows a materially lower wall time than the 28-40s baseline, documented in the tick event.: AC1: src/embedding/search.ts (commit d544776) splits the scan into Pass1 cache-resolve (collects misses, deduped by contentHash, cap counts unique misses) and Pass2 bounded worker pool: `const embedConcurrency = Math.max(1, opts.embedConcurrency ?? DEFAULT_EMBED_CONCURRENCY)` (default 4), shared `nextIdx`, `worker()` while-loop, `await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: embedConcurrency }, worker))`. This is the exact rebuild.ts shape (rebuild.ts:101 `Math.max(1, opts.concurrency ?? 4)`, :124 worker, :156 Promise.all). No serial await remains in the scan loop. AC2: test 'warm cache: scores and order are unchanged by the pooling refactor' asserts 0 provider calls, order a/b/c, scores 1 / sqrt(1/2) / 0; minScore floor logic preserved verbatim (`if (score >= minScore)`, inclusive); 'cachedOnly performs zero provider calls' passes. AC3: src/embedding/search-concurrency.test.ts (10 tests) — 'embeds cache misses concurrently: max in-flight > 1 and <= concurrency' (K=8,C=4: maxInFlight>1 && <=4), 'honors embedConcurrency exactly', 'isolates a failing embed: siblings still rank, the failure is not cached' (failOn text-2 -> c0,c1,c3,c4 ranked, all 5 attempted, text-0 cached), 'pooled wall time tracks ceil(misses/concurrency) x RTT' (K=8,C=4,LAT=100 -> elapsed < 500ms budget vs 800ms serial floor). AC4: `npx vitest run` -> 'Test Files 160 passed (160)', 'Tests 1275 passed (1275)'; `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0; `npx prettier --check src/embedding/search.ts src/embedding/search-concurrency.test.ts src/mcp/tools/recall.ts` -> 'All matched files use Prettier code style!' exit 0. AC5: .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl event 581 (task_id OPS-008, tick 579) documents the post-fix live re-measure of authed GET /api/memories?namespace=duckbrain&q=... on the daemon running d544776: 0.567-1.586s across 4 runs plus fresh-query probes, worst 3.78s vs the 28-40s baseline band, 'the 30s-budget 500s are gone'.
All five acceptance criteria are met: search.ts now embeds cache misses through a bounded worker pool mirroring rebuild.ts, warm-cache behaviour is unchanged, the 10-test regression suite proves concurrency>1 and failure isolation, the full suite (160 files/1275 tests) + tsc + prettier are clean, and the AC5 live re-measure (0.57-3.78s vs 28-40s baseline) is documented in tick event 581.
